prompt: Create one original high-resolution cinematic concept reference image for Ang Lee's 1995 film Sense and Sensibility, as a work-card illustration, not a recreation of any actual film frame, poster, or actor. Source-verified essentials: Jane Austen adaptation, the Dashwood sisters Elinor (sense) and Marianne (sensibility), their reduced circumstances after losing their estate, Regency-era England. Scene: an intimate modest English country cottage interior on a rainy afternoon, two adult sisters with distinct anonymous faces, one composed woman seated at a plain writing desk holding an unfinished letter, the other more impassioned woman standing by a rain-streaked window with closed music folio, both in historically plausible simple Regency gowns, stillness and understated emotional distance between them. Compose as a wide cinematic photograph with clear faces and authentic domestic detail, gentle grey natural window light and warm aged wood, refined but not glossy, visually specific to Austen's social class and sisterly tension. Entire image in natural full-color realism. No recognizable actor likeness, no text, lettering, logo, watermark, border, collage, split screen, or historical anachronisms. Landscape widescreen approximately 16:9; prioritize coherent anatomy, hands, costume, architecture, expression and prop continuity.
